project_type: Full-stack: Strapi v5 CMS (TypeScript/Node) + Go rule engine
build_system: npm for CMS (no explicit build step for Strapi schema), make for engine
test_framework: Strapi admin rebuilds on schema change (npm run build for admin); no automated unit tests for schema changes
build_command: cd cms && npm run build (for admin plugin changes only)
test_command: No automated tests for schema-only changes; verify via Strapi startup and content-type inspection
verification_instructions: 1. For schema changes: restart Strapi dev server to confirm no parse errors. 2. For admin UI changes: npm run build in cms/ then check no build errors. 3. Manual verification: check new enum values appear in Strapi admin UI
environment_constraints: Worktree at /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/engine-cms-sync - all file paths must be absolute to this worktree, never relative or main workspace
contribution_requirements: Three separate commits per the brief: (1) connector types, (2) flow node types, (3) resilience features. Each commit leaves codebase buildable.

key_patterns.component_json_structure: collectionName: components_connection_<name>, info: {displayName, description}, options: {}, attributes: {...}
key_patterns.settings_component_pattern: See postgres-settings.json: credential-free fields only, password via secretRef, no dsn
key_patterns.dynamiczone_pattern: settings field in connection schema lists components in the components array
key_patterns.NODE_PALETTE_pattern: Array of string literals in FlowCanvasField/index.tsx

directory_structure.cms/src/components/connection/: Strapi components for connection settings and resilience
directory_structure.cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/co: Flow canvas UI component with NODE_PALETTE
directory_structure.engine/internal/connect/drivers/: Go driver implementations (mysql, kafka, rabbitmq, etc.)
directory_structure.engine/internal/connect/: Connect package with resilience.go defining ResiliencePolicy
